title: Ira Glass on the Creative Process (www.getoutthebox.org)
summary: A two-minute video of Ira Glass on the creative process, describing the gap between taste and skill when starting out and urging you to keep producing until your work matches your taste.
why: Shared as encouragement for beginners learning design or craft, on persisting through the taste-skill gap.

quote.text: You learn how to differentiate between good and bad much faster than you learn how to create good.
